sql.propToolFinancier.getAllForCompany: select f.id, f.name, f.company_id, f.archived, f.active from props.financier f where f.company_id = :companyId and f.archived is not true order by f.name
sql.propToolFinancier.insert: insert into props.financier(name, company_id, active) values (:name, :companyId, :active)
sql.propToolFinancier.update: update props.financier set name = :name, active = :active where id = :id
sql.propToolFinancier.delete: update props.financier set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
